en.headline: Health spending rose 5 per cent to HK$262.5 billion last year
en.dek: The Health Bureau said recurrent health expenditure in 2024/25 reached HK$262.513 billion, or 8.2 per cent of GDP, with public spending accounting for just over half.
body: The Health Bureau on Wednesday published the Domestic Health Accounts for 2024/25, which track how health spending flowed over a 12-month period. Recurrent health expenditure stood at HK$262.513 billion, up 5.0 per cent, or HK$12.491 billion, from the previous year. That equalled 8.2 per cent of gross domestic product, a similar share to a year earlier. Spending per person was HK$34,890.

Public expenditure accounted for 51.6 per cent of recurrent health spending, or HK$135.450 billion, equal to HK$18,000 per person and 4.2 per cent of GDP. Private spending made up the remaining 48.4 per cent, or HK$127.063 billion, equivalent to 3.9 per cent of GDP. The bureau said both overall recurrent spending and the public share have generally risen as a percentage of GDP over the past decade.

Primary care accounted for 30.4 per cent of recurrent health expenditure in 2024/25. The bureau said that share is moving towards the longer-term balance set out in the Primary Healthcare Blueprint, which aims for primary care to make up about 35 to 40 per cent of total health spending, with secondary and tertiary care taking the rest. The accounts have been posted on the Health Bureau website.

zh.headline: 上年度醫療經常開支2625億 按年增5%
zh.dek: 醫務衞生局公布2024/25年度本地醫療衞生總開支帳目，經常性開支2625.13億元，佔本地生產總值8.2%，人均34890元。
body: 醫務衞生局周三發表2024/25年度《本地醫療衞生總開支帳目》，顯示香港以12個月計的醫療衞生開支流向。醫療衞生經常性開支為2625.13億元，較上年度增加5.0%，即124.91億元，佔本地生產總值8.2%，與上年度佔比相若。人均醫療衞生經常性開支為34890元。
經常性開支當中，公共支出佔51.6%，即1354.50億元，人均公共支出18000元，相當於本地生產總值的4.2%。私人醫療衞生支出佔48.4%，即1270.63億元，相當於本地生產總值的3.9%。局方表示，以相對本地生產總值的百分比計，經常性開支及當中的公共支出在過去十年大致呈上升趨勢。
2024/25年度基層醫療開支佔整體醫療衞生經常性開支30.4%。局方指，有關比例正邁向《基層醫療健康藍圖》提出的長遠目標，即基層醫療與第二、三層醫療開支約為3.5比6.5，甚至4比6。帳目已上載醫務衞生局網頁。
